sections.title: New Features
items: Experimental Logging - Toggle to log every UI interaction, navigation, and app event to log file
Real-time Log Viewer with search, filter, auto-refresh, and share functionality
NUS System Files Downloader - Download system files directly from Nintendo servers without a 3DS
Artic Setup Tool integration - Download system files from real 3DS console over network
Bootrom support - Track boot9.bin, boot11.bin, and sector0x96.bin status
DSP firmware detection - Check for dspfirm.cdc availability
Comprehensive game loading diagnostics - Detailed logging of ROM loading process
All game operations and errors now automatically logged to Documents/Azahar/log/azahar_log.txt

sections.title: Improvements
items: System Files view now shows accurate status for all 14 file types with color coding
Separated C++ Log Level (core emulation) and Experimental Logging (Swift UI events)
Boot Home Menu with region picker for all 7 regions (Japan, USA, Europe, Australia, China, Korea, Taiwan)
Network settings with Artic Base connection for online multiplayer with real 3DS consoles
Enhanced error messages with full context to help diagnose black screen and loading issues
Log file accessible via Settings > Debugging > View Logs or Files app

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed encrypted CIA installation by changing decryption_authorized default to true
Fixed RetroAchievements HTTPS connection errors with proper SSL configuration
Fixed log filter not applying immediately when changed in settings
Fixed log file path to correct Documents/Azahar/log/azahar_log.txt location
Fixed missing mediaType parameter in Game initializers causing compilation errors

sections.title: Previous Features (v1.0.0)
items: StikDebug JIT integration for optimal performance on iOS 17.4+
Auto-enable JIT on launch with user control
RetroAchievements support with full achievement and leaderboard tracking
TXM detection for iOS 26+ with A13/A14/M1+ chips
iOS 26 crash prevention with signal handlers

notes: Enable Experimental Logging in Settings > Debugging to diagnose game loading issues
Log file location: Documents/Azahar/log/azahar_log.txt (accessible via Files app)
Game operations and errors are always logged, regardless of Experimental Logging setting
Use Log Viewer in Settings > Debugging to view, search, and share logs
JIT is recommended for smooth gameplay in most 3DS games
